newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - TAIWAN NEWSPAPERS - AUGUST 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - TAIWAN NEWSPAPERS - AUGUST 13.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Seats in National Assembly and Legislative Yuan to increase under revised election laws.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan and Chad re-establish diplomatic ties.
Premier Lien Chan approves five-day work week, giving public servants two days off every second and fourth weeks of each month.
LIBERTY TIMES - Central African nation of Chad re-establishes ties with Taiwan.
Taipei city government to give monthly allowance to children aged under six.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Southeast Asia currencies drop sharply, benefitting foreign speculators.
Taiwan to implement five-day work week from January 1998.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Stock and foreign exchange markets to close on second and fourth Saturdays of every month from 1998.
Local industries mixed on five-day work week.
